neighbours.label: The split-off piece ' conce' (concealing, conceivably); the whole tokens ' conceal', ' concealed' and synonyms stay quiet
fire: He kept concealing the truth from his wife.
The fog was concealing the ships from view.
It is conceivably the best plan we have.
She is accused of concealing assets from the court.
Without concealing the wound, he walked on.
The plan could conceivably work next year.
The paint was concealing cracks in the wall.
They could conceivably win the next election.
quiet: He concealed the truth from his wife.
The fog could conceal the ships from view.
It is possibly the best plan we have.
She is accused of hiding assets from the court.
Without hiding the wound, he walked on.
The plan could possibly work next year.
The paint concealed cracks in the wall.
They could possibly win the next election.
